# Aarush Joshi — SEO & AI Search Visibility Consultant

> Organic growth advisor with 8+ years across edtech, D2C, BFSI and media. Treats organic search and AI answer engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity) as a P&L-accountable revenue channel — SEO that reports to revenue, not rankings.

Site: https://aarushjoshi.in
Book a 30-minute SEO growth strategy / audit call: https://calendly.com/aarushjoshi/seo-growth-strategy-30-mins-audit-call

## What Aarush does
- AI search visibility audits: which brands ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Perplexity recommend for a category's buying prompts, who gets named instead of you, and what to fix first.
- Revenue-first SEO engines for D2C, edtech, BFSI, enterprise and media brands (India, US, UK, UAE).
- Google Discover and publisher growth programmes.

## Proof (figures reported in the case studies)
- Traya (in-house, D2C hair health): $0 to $450K attributable revenue; non-brand organic traffic 21x in 2 years (1K to 15K+ clicks/day).
- K-12 EdTech (client): $0 to $700K+ revenue in 8 months; organic became 20% of net business.
- India's leading beauty brand (client): blog clicks +157.94% quarter over quarter (78.7K to 203K); leads +25-80%.
- India's leading luxury D2C brand (client): non-brand traffic 260K to 397K/month (+53%); money pages from positions 30-40 to top 5; direct attributable revenue +30% per month.
- Lifestyle publisher, DR < 25 (client): 2.2M Google Discover impressions and 164K clicks in 3 months; quarterly search impressions 4.7M to 24.3M (+414%).
